contract.status: PB1 neutral contract; planned experimental work; not ratified; not part of Brontide Base

purpose: Generalizes the Cooling 'no-capability-transfer' limitation into the neutral contract, so that authority remains local by declaration rather than by fixture convention.

presentationModes.rule: Host and provider are inside one authority domain. A declared Capability presentation may be evaluated at the target boundary.
presentationModes.capabilityCrossesQualifier: Only within the single authority domain; this mode may not be declared for a binding whose realization crosses a declared trust boundary.

presentationModes.rule: No Capability crosses. The provider receives only attributable context and exact addressing, and its own domain performs admission.

carries.detail: An opaque, non-authority-bearing requester attribution such as the Cooling 'requesterLabel' host-context Fragment.
The negotiated Operation reference and, where declared, an addressing-only resource handle.

forbidden.what: a Capability, Constraint expression, or derivation chain in any position
omitting the no-capability-transfer declaration on a trust-crossing binding

constraintPolicy.rule: Unknown actors, capabilities, constraints, Shapes, providers, or operations produce a visible denial or error before effects occur. Authority is never inferred from delivery, possession, provider availability, or structural similarity.

localDenial.rule: A denial or unknown authority condition decided at the local boundary starts no provider and emits no Channel frame.
localDenial.recordingRule: The host still records the attempted Execution locally. A denial is an observation, never an envelope kind; there is no 'denial' frame in channel-envelope.json.
localDenial.divergenceFromExperiments: The Cooling experiment carries a 'denial' message kind on the wire. That is fixture-specific: its denial is emitted by the provider-side host adapter after the frame boundary. The neutral contract keeps local denial frameless, so PB2 and PB3 must not carry the existing denial kind into the portable envelope set.

threeValuedEvaluation.basis: Strong Kleene three-valued logic over Satisfied, Unsatisfied, and Unknown atoms
threeValuedEvaluation.unknownRule: Unknown never resolves to permitted. Only a True expression permits an effect.

chainConjunction.rule: The conjunction of all Constraints along a Capability derivation chain is evaluated at the authorisation boundary.
chainConjunction.portableCeilingRule: The portable contract treats cross-trust chain-conjunction revocability as carried-tier by default. Any resolver or indirection point is a declared capability, never an assumed one.
chainConjunction.rationale: Reference records 'carried' and Minimal records 'resolved'. Carried is the tighter revocation ceiling, so the portable contract must tolerate a carried peer and must not require resolver-based revocation that a carried peer cannot provide.
chainConjunction.capRule: This contract caps neither stack below its recorded ceiling and does not silently downgrade Minimal's resolver-natural revocation.
chainConjunction.pinnedTranscriptionPending: The permanent home for the stack choices is each stack's delivery ledger. Those ledgers are SHA-256 pinned, so transcription awaits the authorized repinning and fresh-review window; representation-choice.md remains the operative record until then.

authorityDecisionPoint.rule: Every completed or rejected interaction records where the authority decision was taken.

enum.detail: Decided at the host boundary before any frame was emitted.
Decided at the target boundary inside one authority domain.
Decided by the provider's own domain after a cross-trust presentation.
